title: Use multiple reference images in a single Seedance 2.5 prompt to keep every…
content: Use multiple reference images in a single Seedance 2.5 prompt to keep every face and outfit locked and prevent morphing/character mixing.
tips: Use multiple reference images in a single Seedance 2.5 prompt to keep every face and outfit locked and prevent morphing/character mixing.

es.content: Usa múltiples imágenes de referencia en un solo prompt de Seedance 2.5 para mantener fijos todos los rostros y atuendos, y evitar la morphing o la mezcla de personajes.

fr.content: Utilisez plusieurs images de référence dans un seul prompt Seedance 2.5 pour conserver fidèlement chaque visage et chaque tenue, et éviter les déformations ou le mélange des personnages.

ja.content: 1つのSeedance 2.5プロンプトで複数の参照画像を使用し、すべての顔と衣装を固定して、形状の変化やキャラクターの混在を防ぎます。

ko.content: 하나의 Seedance 2.5 프롬프트에 여러 개의 레퍼런스 이미지를 사용해 모든 얼굴과 의상을 고정하고, 형태 변형이나 캐릭터 혼합을 방지하세요.

pt.content: Use várias imagens de referência em um único prompt do Seedance 2.5 para manter todos os rostos e roupas fixos e evitar morphing/mistura de personagens.

zh.content: 在单个 Seedance 2.5 prompt 中使用多张参考图像，以锁定每一张脸和每套服装，防止变形或角色混淆。
